from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class HousingDataPoint(BaseModel):
    """A single month of housing construction data extracted from one report."""
    report_date: str | None = Field(description="The date the statistical report was issued")
    data_month: str | None = Field(description="The month the data represents, in YYYY-MM format")
    authorizations_nsa: float | None = Field(description="Not seasonally adjusted total housing authorizations (in thousands)")
    starts_nsa: float | None = Field(description="Not seasonally adjusted total housing starts (in thousands)")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    housing_data_points: list[HousingDataPoint]
